scenes.name: ZECKENDORF
lines: Every natural number is a unique sum of non-adjacent Fibonacci numbers.
每个自然数都唯一地写成互不相邻的 Fibonacci 数之和。

scenes.name: BETA
lines: Swap each weight for a power of the golden ratio, and you get beta of n.
把每个权重换成黄金比 φ 的幂，就得到实数 β(n)。
But beta does not add. The gap is the deficit.
但 β 不保持加法，差额就是亏量 c。

scenes.name: CARRY
lines: To add, sum the digits, then carry until every digit is zero or one, with no ones adjacent.
相加时先逐位求和，再不断进位，直到每位只是 0 或 1，且没有相邻的 1。
Every carry keeps beta, except the two lowest doubling rules: they count plus one and minus one.
除了最低的两条“加倍”规则，每次进位都保持 β 不变；这两条分别计 +1 和 −1。

scenes.name: THREE VALUES
lines: So the deficit is an integer, the signed count of those bottom carries.
所以亏量是整数：正是这些底部进位的带符号计数。
For every input it is minus one, zero, or one. Lean has checked both theorems.
而且对所有输入，它只取 −1、0、1。两条定理都已由 Lean 内核检验。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Golden Integers and Observability, chapter one.
《黄金整数与可观测性》· 第一章
